rules.name: Indian Financial Year
rules.description: Financial year starts April 1 and ends March 31. FY2023-24 = April 1, 2023 to March 31, 2024.
rules.sql_pattern: CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_column) >= 4 THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_column) ELSE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_column) - 1 END

rules.name: Quarter Definition
rules.description: Q1=Apr-Jun, Q2=Jul-Sep, Q3=Oct-Dec, Q4=Jan-Mar. Stored in employee_performance.quarter and financial_year.

rules.name: Active Employee Default
rules.description: When counting or listing employees without explicit status filter, default to status = 'ACTIVE'.

rules.name: Salary Means Current Salary
rules.description: When referring to 'salary' without qualification, use employees.salary (current monthly salary).

rules.name: Branch Location Join Path
rules.description: To get state/region for a branch: branches → zones → regions → states.

rules.name: Indian Currency Formatting
rules.description: Large amounts should be expressed in lakhs (1,00,000) or crores (1,00,00,000) when presenting to executives.

rules.name: NPA Classification
rules.description: Loans with status = 'NPA' are Non-Performing Assets. risk_category values: STANDARD → SMA1 → SMA2 → SUBSTANDARD → DOUBTFUL → LOSS.

rules.name: Employee Productivity Metric
rules.description: Employee productivity is measured by employee_performance.productivity_score (0-10 scale). Use this field for any question about 'productivity'.

rules.name: Attrition Calculation
rules.description: Attrition = employees whose status changed to RESIGNED or TERMINATED during the period. Use exit_date to filter by period.

rules.name: Joined After Date
rules.description: 'Joined after April 2020' means employees.join_date > '2020-04-01'. 'Joined after 2020' means join_date >= '2020-01-01'.

rules.name: Loan Portfolio
rules.description: Loan portfolio = SUM(outstanding_amount) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'. For growth calculations, compare across fiscal years.

rules.name: High Value Customer
rules.description: Customer with total_balance > 25 lakhs OR annual_income > 50 lakhs OR segment = 'HNI'.

rules.name: Year-over-Year Comparison
rules.description: YoY = ((current_period_value - previous_period_value) / previous_period_value) * 100. Use same period definitions (FY or calendar year).

rules.name: Consecutive Quarter Detection
rules.description: To detect trends across consecutive quarters, use LAG/LEAD window functions partitioned by entity (branch/employee) and ordered by financial_year, quarter.
